The *Maggārammaṇattika* is the seventeenth triad (*tika*) of the first division of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the final treatise of the Abhidhamma Piṭṭhaka in the Pali Tipiṭaka [SuttaCentral]. It systematically examines conditional relations (*paccaya*) applied to dhammas grouped according to the triad concerning the path as object. SuttaCentral records one modern translation of the text in one language [SuttaCentral].
